instruction: For each independently priced unloading window in bay_addendum, award exactly one whole offer for the frame lot and one for the panel lot. Every offer is available in every window, and any frame offer can pair with any panel offer. Their pallet counts add even when carriers match and must fit within the window's inclusive pallet cap. Submit a SQLite SELECT that produces the requested output using the supplied tables.

instruction: Issue one allocation for the single closure described in closure_order. Select exactly two distinct complete shuttle offers from different vehicle pools. instruction: A park has 12 crew-days available before opening day. Choose a nonempty subset of the three proposed trails to maximize the sum of their visitor capacity gains, measured in visitors per day. Each trail needs one preparation site completed before its own finishing work. Pay the site's crew-days once if any selected trail needs it, plus every selected trail's finish_days. Crew-days are pooled and the work may be sequenced freely with preparation first. Among feasible portfolios with equal capacity gain, prefer fewer crew-days, then the smaller selection mask. The distinct trail_bit values 1, 2 and 4 identify the trails; their sum encodes the selected subset. Site IDs are unique in prep_site and every trail references an existing site. All values are non-null. Return one row with columns selection_mask, capacity_gain, crew_days. Submit a SQLite SELECT that produces the requested output using the supplied tables.
